variantNote: South African Sesotho spellings (Pherekgong, Motsheanong, Tshitwe). Lesotho orthography differs: Phesekgong/Pherekgong, Mots'eanong, Tšitoe, Mmesa. April is written Mmesa by most SA sources; Mmese also appears.
note: Machine draft, not fluent-speaker approved. Short forms are 3-letter; Hla (Hlakola) vs Hlk (Hlakubele) are deliberately distinct. Least certain points are spelling variants (Mmesa/Mmese, Pherekgong/Phesekgong), not which month a name refers to.
